tasks.instructions:
### Task 31a: close the pre-PR ledger — eight defects, most of them in already-APPROVED code

**This task runs FIRST and it is not cleanup.** Every item below was found by a review that APPROVED
the work containing it, or was proven pre-existing at HEAD. Several change what the artifacts
contain, which is exactly why they land BEFORE the golden is generated in task 2 — a golden pinned
over these would pin the defects.

**Files:** `demoflow/src/demoflow/output/tripwires.py`, `demoflow/src/demoflow/pipeline.py`,
`demoflow/src/demoflow/cli.py`, and their tests.

---

**L1 (the one that matters most). TWO OF THE THREE COMPLETENESS CLAUSES PIN THE FIRST ONE, so the
first is unpinned and a test is passing for the wrong reason.** Measured by run 29's reviewer and
proven PRE-EXISTING at HEAD, so this is not a regression — it is ours and it is open:

- Mutating the province-wide month check from vocabulary equality to a bare `len(set(months)) != 12`
  **survives the FULL suite** (58 passed working tree / 53 passed HEAD).
- `test_closed_year_check_is_vocabulary_bound_not_a_count` is killed by the MODELED-MEMBER clause,
  not by the vocabulary rule its own name claims to test.
- Deleting the province-wide month clause OUTRIGHT also survives at both trees.

This is the same class as the §6-coupling defect amendment #14 recorded: **a guard whose test passes
for the wrong reason.** Fix the test so it isolates the clause it names — the difficulty is real,
because a renamed month token is already refused at load by `_check_periods`, so think about whether
the surviving reachable threat is a DIRECTLY CONSTRUCTED frame and say so in the test's own words.
Then prove it: the bare-count mutant and the delete-the-clause mutant must BOTH red, and each must
red on a test whose name describes the rule it is defending.

**L2. `Reason.DUPLICATE_INDICATOR` is absent from `NULLABLE_REASONS` while `MISSING_INDICATOR` is
present.** `check_registry` emits a duplicate record with `current_value=None` and `as_of=None`, so
that record FAILS `assert_tripwire_record_valid`'s non-null branch. Latent in committed Task-28 code;
unreachable today only because nothing emits a duplicate — which means the contract and the producer
disagree and no test crosses them. **That is the exact shape of the 64-vs-16 hash seam run 30 found.**

**THE FIX DIRECTION IS RULED, AND THE SPEC EDIT IS THE SEAT'S, NOT YOURS.** `NULLABLE_REASONS`
mirrors a CLOSED enumeration in spec §7c ("nullable exactly when reason ∈ {source_unavailable,
operator_input_missing, missing_indicator, non_finite}"), so widening it is fork-class — the same
reason run 29's mandate forbade adding a `Reason` member. The seat rules it: a duplicate record has
no honest measurement, which is the identical logic that put the other four in, so
`DUPLICATE_INDICATOR` joins them, and **the seat authors spec amendment #16 at fold, in the same
commit as your code** (the amendment-#15 pattern). **You implement the code change and the SEAM
TEST — a record produced by `check_registry` must validate** — and you do NOT touch the spec and do
NOT add a new `Reason` member.

**L3. A silent-zero door survives on the model path** — `listings.get(t, 0.0)` at `pipeline.py:732`,
in a module whose own docstring says "Every silent-zero door on the model path refuses instead."
Unreachable as written (the supply loop keys `voluntary` at every year 2021–2051), but it is the
deflating-door shape and the docstring currently overstates. Either make it refuse, or narrow the
docstring — **and if you narrow it, the claim must become true, not vaguer.**

**L4. `HORIZON_YEARS` has no consumer anywhere in Tranche 1**, and
`test_horizons_are_the_declared_set` asserts a module literal against the same literal — it cannot
fail for any reason connected to the run. **This is the SEAT's defect**: the mandate carried it in by
transcribing the plan's named test cases. **REMOVAL of both is the expected outcome.** Keeping the
constant is acceptable ONLY if you find a PRE-EXISTING Tranche-1 need for it — inventing a consumer
to justify the constant is worse than the vacuous test, because it makes dead weight look load-bearing.

**L5. The `demoflow tripwires` listing carries no identity or vintage line.** No `assumptions_hash`,
no `data_vintage` — so a listing is unattributable to the data it was computed from, and it can
disagree with a committed `tripwire_baseline.json` with no field on either side revealing it. Print
the identity with the listing.

**L7. `QUEBEC_REQUIRED_CMAS` has no pin inside `test_ircc_loader.py`**, the test module for the
file that owns it — its only binding lives in `test_tripwires.py`. Placement, not absence, and you
are already in these files. Add the pin.

**L8. `_member_set_note` is wired only into the empty-closed-years branch**, so a truncated 2027 while
2026 is closed is never named in the run log. Bounded today by the freshness gate and by
`year = max(years)` selecting the honest year, so it is NOT a verdict risk — it is the third
unchecked sibling of the discriminator's cause set. Either wire it on the evaluated-year path too, or
record in the code why the bound is sufficient. **A stated bound is an acceptable close here; silence
is not.**

**L6. One word of citation precision.** `demand/immigrant_inputs.py:25` attributes the per-field
provenance split to "ruling T". Rulings Q and T BOTH produce mixed pairs (Q: MTL/QC cited ratio beside
borrowed headship; T: RA06/RA13 measured, not borrowed), so the citation is defensible but narrow.
Name both. Trivial — do it only if you are already in the file.

**Guardrail:** L1–L8 are in code that a review already APPROVED. Do not take the approval as evidence
the rest of those modules is clean, and do not weaken any existing gate to make a fix easier. If a fix
requires relaxing something, STOP and report — that trade is the seat's.

SEAT-RUN ADDENDUM (binding): commit NOTHING — the seat commits at run close after its own diff review. RED-first binds. Run-unique scratchpad subdir; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 for mutation batteries; probe on COPIES and never disable a guard in the live tree. Finish with `./scripts/test-all.sh` from the worktree root; real tail, figures derived from that run and never transcribed.

tasks.title: Task 31b — Task 30 golden artifacts, restatement-aware and deterministic
tasks.instructions:
### Task 31b: Task 30 — golden artifacts, made RESTATEMENT-AWARE and DETERMINISTIC

Task 1 of this run lands first and changes what the artifacts contain; generate the golden AFTER it.

**Plan bytes, extracted mechanically:**

### Task 30: Golden artifacts (committed rankings + tripwire baseline; generate → commit → diff)

**Files:**
- Create (by running): `demoflow/artifacts/rankings.json`, `demoflow/artifacts/tripwire_baseline.json`
- Test: `demoflow/tests/test_golden.py`

Golden = generate from the committed data vintage, COMMIT the output, then a regression
test re-runs and diffs. No exact numbers are pre-known here (they follow from the committed
vintage); the golden is the pin.

- [ ] **Step 1: Generate + commit the golden artifacts**

Run:
```bash
cd demoflow && uv run demoflow run --out artifacts
cat demoflow/artifacts/rankings.json | head -30
```
Expected: writes `demoflow/artifacts/rankings.json` + `demoflow/artifacts/tripwire_baseline.json`,
JSON with `allow_nan=False`, sorted keys. Inspect that ranks are contiguous from 1, geographies
are string values, and `flags` carries `ra_proxy` on the RA members.

- [ ] **Step 2: Write the regression (golden-diff) test**

`demoflow/tests/test_golden.py`:
```python
import json
from pathlib import Path

from demoflow.pipeline import run_pipeline

GOLDEN = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "artifacts"

# THIRD, TEST-OWNED copy of the code-required indicator name list (codex r4-F4): a
# co-deletion must touch code (REQUIRED_INDICATORS) + baseline (golden) + this test in ONE
# PR-visible diff — the residual guard no runtime check can provide.
_REQUIRED_INDICATOR_NAMES = {
    "pr_landings_annual", "temp_resident_stock", "isq_edition_watch",
    "registre_foncier_volume", "cmhc_senior_sale_5yr", "natural_increase_sign",
}


def test_rankings_match_golden(tmp_path):
    run_pipeline(out_dir=tmp_path, now_year=2026)
    fresh = json.loads((tmp_path / "rankings.json").read_text())
    committed = json.loads((GOLDEN / "rankings.json").read_text())
    assert fresh == committed


def test_tripwire_baseline_matches_golden(tmp_path):
    run_pipeline(out_dir=tmp_path, now_year=2026)
    fresh = json.loads((tmp_path / "tripwire_baseline.json").read_text())
    committed = json.loads((GOLDEN / "tripwire_baseline.json").read_text())
    assert fresh == committed
    inds = {t["indicator"] for t in committed["indicators"]}
    assert _REQUIRED_INDICATOR_NAMES <= inds       # literal name list pinned here (third copy)


def test_golden_is_strict_json_no_nan():
    for name in ("rankings.json", "tripwire_baseline.json"):
        text = (GOLDEN / name).read_text()
        assert "NaN" not in text and "Infinity" not in text
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Run to verify it passes**

Run: `cd demoflow && uv run pytest tests/test_golden.py -v`
Expected: 3 PASS (fresh run reproduces the committed golden deterministically).

- [ ] **Step 4: Commit**

```bash
git add demoflow/artifacts/rankings.json demoflow/artifacts/tripwire_baseline.json demoflow/tests/test_golden.py
git commit -m "test(demoflow): committed golden rankings + tripwire baseline (generate->commit->diff)"
```

**End of T1c session boundary.**


---

## SEAT CARRIES — the plan body's golden is not reproducible, and the audit is the seat's

**G1. THE GOLDEN'S DETERMINISM CURRENTLY RESTS ON THE ABSENCE OF AN UNTRACKED FILE.** Measured:
`demoflow/data/` IS committed (13 files) and is NOT gitignored, but the IRCC feed
(`ircc_pr_by_cma.csv`) is deliberately ABSENT — committing it would flip the tripwire's live state
from UNKNOWN to wired. So today `load_pr_landings()` reports unavailable and the golden would pin
UNKNOWN / `source_unavailable` / exit 1, reproducibly. **The moment anyone drops the feed into
`data/` — the natural thing to do to make the indicator live — the golden reds with no code change,
and it then fails in any checkout WITHOUT the file.** Environment-dependent in both directions, and the fix is not a
judgment call: **RULED — DECLARED-ABSENT, and fixture-backed is REJECTED.** A fixture-backed golden
stamps a non-live vintage into a committed artifact and muddies precisely the data-vs-code
attribution G10 exists to protect; the repo's deliberate absence of the feed IS the honest committed
state. So the golden pins UNKNOWN / `source_unavailable`, with the data source EXPLICIT rather than
ambient, and the reason recorded where a reader meets it.

**G2. THE EXIT CODE DISCRIMINATES NOTHING TODAY, so do not pin a verdict into it.** All six
indicators are structurally UNKNOWN (one wired feed uncommitted, two wired to nothing, three
operator-supplied with no operator input), so `run_exit_code` returns 1 on every vintage. A golden
that pins "1" pins a constant, and it will red the day the first real input lands — which is success,
not regression. Say so where the golden lives.

**G3. FRESHNESS GOES WALL-CLOCK-DEPENDENT the moment a real indicator value lands, and NO artifact
field records the injected `now`.** The tripwire document's keys are `[assumptions_hash,
data_vintage, indicators, schema, schema_version]`. The golden is reproducible today only because
everything is UNKNOWN. **THE SEAT RULES THIS RATHER THAN DELEGATING IT**, because it is a contract choice like the
exit-code contract before it, and because one of the two options is not even reachable in-lane: the
envelope's field allowlist is spec-closed and the artifacts walk RAISES on an undeclared position, so
recording `now` in the document is amendment territory, not an implementation choice.

**RULED: ONE PINNED `now`, shared by the golden generator and the golden test, with the generation
path COMMITTED** (a script, or an invocation documented where the golden lives) so the golden's
provenance carries the `now` the artifact itself cannot. **Normalizing time-varying positions out of
the diff is REJECTED** — byte-equality is the golden's entire value, and a diff with holes in it is a
golden that stopped pinning the thing it was built to pin. Recording `now` inside the document is a
FUTURE amendment, to be taken when the first real indicator input lands; the golden's own
documentation names that as an expected re-mint rather than a failure.

**G4. `extracted_at` is ALREADY SETTLED — seat-verified, do not re-open it.** Run 30's B6 fix made it
per-source DECLARED PROVENANCE, read from each artifact's own `_provenance` block; the seat confirmed
there is NO wall-clock read anywhere in `pipeline.py` or `artifacts.py`, and the live emitted values
genuinely differ per source (2026-07-21 / 2026-08-08 / 2026-08-15). It is stable across runs and it
BELONGS in the golden.

**G5. `test_golden_is_strict_json_no_nan` is weaker than it looks.** A substring scan for `"NaN"` /
`"Infinity"` MISSES `1e999`, which `json.loads` parses to `inf`, and false-reds on any legitimate
string containing those letters. The document is already written with `allow_nan=False`, so this test
should verify the READ side — parse with a `parse_constant` hook that raises.

**G6. Both golden tests bind AMBIENTLY to the real data dir** — `run_pipeline(out_dir=tmp_path,
now_year=2026)` passes no `data_dir`. Make the source explicit.

**G7. The suite would run the whole model EIGHT times.** Each golden test calls `run_pipeline`, which
runs the ED grid once plus the three-leg `rank_stability` sweep. Two tests → eight full grids, on top
of Task 29's own pipeline tests — and the demoflow suite already takes ~2m38s. Use a session-scoped
fixture, or the gate becomes slow enough that people stop running it.

**G8. KEEP the third indicator-name copy.** `_REQUIRED_INDICATOR_NAMES` in the test is DELIBERATE
(codex r4-F4): a co-deletion must then touch code + golden + test in one PR-visible diff. **Do not
"DRY" it away** — it is the residual guard no runtime check can provide.

**G9. Step 1's shell block is wrong after its own `cd`** (`cd demoflow && … && cat
demoflow/artifacts/…`). Trivial; noted so it does not cost a cycle.

**G10. RESTATEMENT AWARENESS is the point of the whole task.** IRCC restates ~0.4–0.7% of overlapping
cells per vintage a decade deep and the ISQ workbooks are re-published, so a golden pinning computed
values reds on upstream refresh with NO code change. The envelope now covers 12 inputs — use it: a
red must be ATTRIBUTABLE to data-vs-code by reading the artifact, and the golden's own documentation
must tell a future reader which kind of red they are looking at and what to do about it.

SEAT-RUN ADDENDUM (binding): commit NOTHING — the seat commits at run close after its own diff review. RED-first binds. Run-unique scratchpad subdir; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 for mutation batteries; probe on COPIES and never disable a guard in the live tree. Finish with `./scripts/test-all.sh` from the worktree root; real tail, figures derived from that run and never transcribed.
